title: Grass Creepers
description: A modern grass-style creeper texture designed to restore its original purpose: blending naturally into the plains biomes.
body:
This pack gives Creepers a modern grass-styled texture designed to restore it's original purpose: blending naturally into the plains biomes. 

It only really blends in that well in the plains, but its sure to update it's look, to hopefuly what you will consider a more pleasant look. 

One thing for sure is, it will blend better than its outdated texture.
